vocabulary.meaning_en: a promise to yourself to do something better, often at the start of a new year

vocabulary.meaning_en: to look carefully for something

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a quiet, gentle way

vocabulary.meaning_en: before the usual or right time

vocabulary.meaning_en: special clothes an actor wears to look like someone or something
vocabulary.example: The children wore animal costumes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put on clothes to see if they fit
vocabulary.example: Can I try on these shoes?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be the right size for someone
vocabulary.example: These jeans don't fit me. They are too small.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very good; great (informal)

vocabulary.note_en: Adverb: awesomely - rare, Anna uses it for fun.
vocabulary.example: The view from the mountain is awesome!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a tall plant with a trunk, branches and leaves
vocabulary.example: There is a big tree in our garden.

fine_lines.title: adjective vs adverb: soft / softly
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصفة تصف الاسم (a soft voice)، والظرف يصف الفعل - كيف يحدث الفعل (She speaks softly). معظم الظروف = الصفة + ly.
fine_lines.explanation_en: An adjective describes a noun (a soft voice). An adverb describes a verb - how you do it (She speaks softly). Most adverbs are adjective + ly.

fine_lines.title: too vs enough
fine_lines.explanation_ar: too قبل الصفة أو الظرف معناها «أكثر من اللازم» (too softly). enough بعد الصفة أو الظرف معناها «بالقدر الكافي» (loud enough).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Too comes before an adjective or adverb and means "more than you want" (too softly). Enough comes after it and means "as much as you need" (loud enough).

fine_lines.title: early / late: no -ly
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بعض الكلمات تكون صفة وظرفاً بنفس الشكل بدون ly: early, late, fast, hard. لا نقول lately بمعنى متأخراً (lately معناها «مؤخراً»).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Some words are the same as adjective and adverb, with no -ly: early, late, fast, hard. Do not say "lately" for "late" - lately means "recently".

examples.sentence: You need to say it earlier.

grammar.title: Adverbs of manner (how we do something)
grammar.explanation_ar: ظرف الحال يصف كيف نقوم بالفعل، ويأتي عادةً بعد الفعل أو بعد المفعول به. نكوّنه بإضافة ly إلى الصفة: soft → softly، loud → loudly، slow → slowly، quiet → quietly. إذا انتهت الصفة بـ y نغيرها إلى i: happy → happily. إذا انتهت بـ le نحذف e ونضيف y: gentle → gently. وانتبه: good → well.
grammar.explanation_en: Adverbs of manner tell us how someone does something. They usually come after the verb (or after the object). Make them by adding -ly to the adjective: soft → softly, loud → loudly, slow → slowly, quiet → quietly. If the adjective ends in -y, change it to -i: happy → happily. If it ends in -le, drop the e and add y: gentle → gently. Careful: good → well.

grammar.title: too + adverb / adverb + enough
grammar.explanation_ar: too تأتي قبل الظرف وتعني «أكثر من اللازم» (مشكلة). enough تأتي بعد الظرف وتعني «بالقدر الكافي». ونستخدم more + الظرف للمقارنة: more loudly, more seriously. ومع الظروف القصيرة نضيف er: earlier, later, faster.
grammar.explanation_en: Too comes before an adverb and means "more than is good" (a problem). Enough comes after an adverb and means "as much as needed". For comparisons use more + adverb: more loudly, more seriously. Short adverbs take -er: earlier, later, faster.
examples: You said that line too late.
You need to say it earlier.

questions.question: Choose the adverb: "Walk ____, please. The baby is sleeping."
questions.explanation_ar: نحتاج ظرفاً يصف الفعل walk، فنقول quietly.
questions.explanation_en: We need an adverb to describe the verb "walk": quietly.

questions.explanation_ar: resolution عهد تقطعه على نفسك لتكون أفضل.
questions.explanation_en: A resolution is a promise to yourself to be better.

choices: Your voice is not loud enough.

questions.explanation_en: Too softly means your voice is not loud enough.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: enough تأتي بعد الصفة: loud enough.
questions.explanation_en: Enough comes after the adjective: loud enough.

questions.question: What is the adverb of "good"?

questions.explanation_en: A costume is the special clothes an actor wears.

questions.explanation_ar: عكس late هو early، والمقارنة earlier.
questions.explanation_en: The opposite of late is early; the comparison is earlier.

questions.question: Before an actor gets a part, they often have to ...

questions.question: "That costume fits you perfectly." This means ...

questions.explanation_en: Fits perfectly means it is exactly the right size.

questions.question: Which word is an adverb?
questions.explanation_en: Suddenly is an adverb (sudden + ly). The others are adjectives.
